factual_methodological.summary: Material claims were previously checked against the IMF primary release; revision 1 changes only controlled taxonomy and PT-BR localization. No figures, dates, causal claims, scenarios, visual values or factual conclusions changed.

taxonomy.summary: The controlled institutional-change phenomenon is valid and all other controlled values remain valid.

translation.summary: Executive Board, Board and Guidance Note references are now naturally localized in PT-BR while semantic parity with EN is preserved.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Direct opening, informative headings, natural localization, no template or QA meta-text, controlled repetition and coherent progression from framework change to debt modules, judgment, data quality and implementation.

contextual_depth.summary: The report connects the 2026 revision to changes in financing structure and institutional decision channels without ornamental historical material.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: The brief meets the visual floor; visual values and mechanism are unchanged from the fact-checked rejected version and remain equivalent across locales.

contrary_evidence: The revised framework changes analytical rules rather than debt stocks themselves; country outcomes will depend on implementation and structured judgment.
limitations: Implementation effects cannot yet be observed because the revised framework is expected to become operational in the second half of 2027.
Temporary non-publication of parts of the mechanical signal will limit external reproducibility during transition.
notes: Revision 1 resolves the blocking taxonomy and PT-BR localization issues recorded in the prior rejection. No public bundle for this ID was found at decision time.

en.title: The IMF–World Bank debt framework is changing how low-income sovereign risk is assessed
en.deck: The 2026 LIC-DSF review adds domestic-debt and long-term modules, recalibrates debt-stress thresholds, introduces new model signals and data-confidence treatment, while keeping the harmonised discount rate at 5%.
en.regime: Debt assessment for low-income countries is moving toward broader coverage of domestic debt, long-term investment needs and more granular risk classification.
en.key_risk: Greater analytical complexity and temporary non-publication of some mechanical signals can make country assessments harder to interpret during transition.

pt-BR.title: O marco FMI–Banco Mundial muda a avaliação do risco de dívida em países de baixa renda
pt-BR.deck: A revisão de 2026 do LIC-DSF adiciona módulos de dívida doméstica e longo prazo, recalibra limiares de estresse, introduz novos sinais de modelo e tratamento da confiança nos dados, mantendo a taxa harmonizada de desconto em 5%.
pt-BR.regime: A avaliação da dívida de países de baixa renda passa a cobrir melhor dívida doméstica, necessidades de investimento de longo prazo e classificações de risco mais granulares.
pt-BR.key_risk: Maior complexidade analítica e a não publicação temporária de alguns sinais mecânicos podem dificultar a interpretação das avaliações durante a transição.
